The art of
looking twice.

  1. Solve the nine clues. The answers become your tiles.
  2. Find three groups of three. Group all nine answers by one theme. Those three groups are the first truth.
  3. Find another three groups of three. Regroup the same answers in a different way. That’s the second truth.
